analyst: This Pine Script is a session-based strategy that builds a volume profile over a lookback and marks the POC and its high/low bands. It opens longs when a pivot low is above the POC high while the long setup is armed, and opens shorts when a pivot high is below the POC low while the short setup is armed. Entries are also limited by the entry end time and a maximum number of entries per day. The stop is a dollar stop: long_stop is the average entry price minus stop_dollars divided by point value, and short_stop is the average entry price plus that amount. It exits at that stop, at the dollar take-profit, or at session end.
